entities.createSql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `word` TEXT NOT NULL, `normalized_word` TEXT NOT NULL, `gender` TEXT NOT NULL, `part_of_speech` TEXT NOT NULL, `plural` TEXT, `ipa` TEXT, `audio_url` TEXT, `meanings_json` TEXT NOT NULL, `examples_json` TEXT NOT NULL, `noun_declension_json` TEXT, `verb_conjugation_json` TEXT, `is_saved` INTEGER NOT NULL, `last_viewed_at` INTEGER)

indices.name: index_words_normalized_word
indices.createSql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_words_normalized_word` ON `${TABLE_NAME}` (`normalized_word`)

contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_words_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `words` BEGIN DELETE FROM `words_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_words_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `words` BEGIN DELETE FROM `words_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_words_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `words` BEGIN INSERT INTO `words_fts`(`docid`, `word`, `normalized_word`, `meanings_json`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`word`, NEW.`normalized_word`, NEW.`meanings_json`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_words_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `words` BEGIN INSERT INTO `words_fts`(`docid`, `word`, `normalized_word`, `meanings_json`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`word`, NEW.`normalized_word`, NEW.`meanings_json`); END
entities.createSql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`word` TEXT NOT NULL, `normalized_word` TEXT NOT NULL, `meanings_json` TEXT NOT NULL, content=`words`)
